descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S03 Existing api specs: add method and context tagging, every removal, duplicate outcomes, impossible outcomes refused, removals kept on account deletion

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Adding a patient by scan and by manual entry is logged, each add tagged by method (scan vs manual), in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 1; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U2 Removing / discharging a patient is logged, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 2; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U3 A duplicate-detection prompt logs that it was shown, and logs whether the physician accepted or rejected it (manual add and scan, both contexts) (UAT OAT-06 Test 3; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 AC 5)
  • U12 Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize … (UAT OAT-06 closing line; TFA-94514 AC 8; TFA-94609 AC 5; TFA-94609 AC 6)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Local backend; Tim's api fixtures

When Hospital manual add + census bulkImport (and its retry with the same request id), then remove all three; Nursing Home manual add + resident-list scan (and retry); duplicate prompt shown then accepted / shown then rejected; delete an account holding 2 Hospital and 1 Nursing Home patients; …

Then Hospital: 3 patient_added (1 manual, 2 scan_census), a retried import adds none, 3 patient_removed with removalReason manual. Nursing Home: 2 patient_added (manual, scan_census) and one scan_census_completed with selected 2 / linked 1 / created 1. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright api assertions. These call the mutations directly: they prove the store tags, keeps and guards the rows (U12 'fire correctly' against bad input), not that the screens call them (S01, S02, S04, S05). Nursing Home manual removal (snf.remove from a screen) has no spec (S22)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S03

Existing api specs: add method and context tagging, every removal, duplicate outcomes, impossible outcomes refused, removals kept on account deletion

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa); TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa); TFA-94609 Pilot Surveys (ready for pr)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-06.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/account-deletion.spec.ts [api] — deleting an account removes its data and identity, keeps the trail, and leaves colleagues untouched — expected
  • api/account-deletion.spec.ts [api] — a patient removal reason of account_deleted cannot be claimed by a client — expected
  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — Hospital add methods and every removal are recorded — expected
  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — Nursing Home manual and resident-list scan adds are distinguished — expected
  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — duplicate prompts record shown and the physician outcome — expected
  • api/patient-activity.spec.ts [api] — duplicate prompt state rejects impossible or conflicting outcomes — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's api specs (patient-activity.spec.ts, account-deletion.spec.ts), which sign in their own fixture accounts, call the mutations directly and judge the rows with the local stack's admin key; dev has none of these, and Delete account is refused there (runner-contract §10, §10.4), so …. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
